title: Layer Impact Completion Gate Result (N1)
description: Output of scripts/layer-impact-gate.ts. Extends the Unified Result Schema (result.schema.json) with layer-aware fields required by the N1 milestone (north-star priority A). Consumed by response.completed / pre-commit / pre-push hooks and by the record-update-executor (N5).

id.description: Unified Result Schema id, but constrained to the LAYER-IMPACT subnamespace so logs can be filtered.

status.description: pass = no missing layer / fail = at least one impacted layer is missing a corresponding record update / error = analysis itself failed (parse error, missing input).

humanRequired.description: True when at least one impacted layer cannot be auto-resolved and a structured ask (Principle 17) must be raised. Hooks treat this as a force-gate.

changedFiles.description: Input files that were considered. Typically the staged set (pre-commit), the diff to-be-pushed (pre-push), or recent_tool_calls writes (response.completed).

layerImpact.description: Per-layer impact summary. Each of the 5 core record layers (DDD/SDD/BDD/TDD/ADR) gets an entry. A layer is marked impacted=true when the resolver believes the change should update at least one record in that layer.

missingLayers.description: Convenience projection: list of layer keys where impacted=true AND updated=false. This is the trigger set for the force-gate ask and for the record-update-executor (N5).

resolverVersion.description: Identifier of the reference resolver (N2) snapshot that produced layerImpact. Null until N2 lands; until then layerImpact is heuristic-only.

impacted.description: True when the resolver thinks this layer needs an update because of the changed files.

updated.description: True when at least one record under this layer was actually touched in changedFiles (or by a recorded decision in this hook cycle).

candidateRecords.description: Resolver-suggested record paths/ids that the executor or human should consider updating. Empty array is valid (Principle 10 Empty-Container Tolerance).

reason.description: Why the resolver thinks this layer is impacted (or not). Helps human auditing without re-running.
